landing.metaTitle: Argano — geared lift machine check for replacements
landing.metaDescription: Traction, rope, motor, brake and shaft checks for replacing a geared lift machine, with an automatic proposal and a PDF calculation report.
landing.h1: Argano: choosing and checking the geared machine for a replacement
landing.answer: Argano checks whether a geared machine suits the existing lift — traction in the three conditions of UNI EN 81-50, ropes, motor, brake, manual rescue and shaft — or proposes one, and prepares the calculation report (relazione di calcolo) for the technical file.
landing.status: In validation: an engineer is checking the normative values and access is by invitation. Results stay indicative until the verification checklist is signed.
landing.feature1Text: Traction at loading, in emergency braking (8 cases, also at the brake’s real deceleration) and with the car stalled; ropes, D/d and safety factor; power and torque; brake; manual rescue; shaft and anchor loads.
landing.feature2Text: When no machine has been chosen yet, Argano proposes sheave, groove, ratio, IEC motor and brake setting. In a replacement it keeps the number and diameter of the existing ropes.
landing.feature3Text: From every saved calculation, a report in Italian with the data, the checks, the clauses and the status of every normative value, ready to be checked and signed.
landing.feature4Text: Every calculation is an immutable snapshot with engine version, normative profile and SHA-256 fingerprint: the same data always give the same result.
landing.step1Text: Rated load, car mass, balance, speed, travel, machine layout (top, with a deflector or bottom) and geometry.
landing.step2Text: The nameplate data of the offered machine or the software’s proposal, compared with the existing machine.
landing.step3Text: Result in brief with a traffic light per area, complete technical tables and a PDF calculation report from the saved calculation.
landing.normsTitle: Which standards is it based on?
landing.normsLead: The software’s Italian normative profile includes:
landing.normsNote: Profile {profile}. Every value the software uses is tied to a document and clause in the standards registry; values from secondary sources are marked ⚠ until they are checked against the current text.
landing.faq1q: Does Argano replace the report signed by the technician?
landing.faq1a: No. Argano prepares the calculations and the report; the document becomes a calculation report when a qualified technician checks and signs it, and the responsibility stays with them.
landing.faq2q: Does it work with the machine at the bottom?
landing.faq2a: Yes. The calculation follows the rope path for a top machine with direct pull, a top machine with a deflector and a bottom machine with two pulleys at the top, including the upward load on the shaft.
landing.faq3q: Can I keep the existing ropes in a replacement?
landing.faq3a: Yes, that is the default: the new ropes have the same number and diameter as the installed ones, and the proposal keeps them too.
landing.faq4a: On servers in the European Union. A company’s projects are visible only to the users of that company.
landing.faq5a: The interface is in Italian, English and Bulgarian; the calculation report is in Italian.
landing.machineAlt: Geared machine on its bedplate: motor with cooling fins, drum brake with electromagnet, worm gearbox, handwheel for emergency operation and traction sheave with four ropes.
landing.machineCaption: The machine of the calculator’s example A: sheave D 560 mm, 4 ropes Ø 10 mm, ratio 1:43, 7.5 kW motor. Illustrative model, not a real product.

lift.hint_dx_tight: With this plan the rope cannot drop where the plan puts the counterweight, with either a simple or a reverse bend: measure dx (and h) on the installation and enter them, or review the layout or the sheave.
lift.hint_machine_auto: Sheave, ropes, ratio, groove, motor and brake chosen by the sizing: they pass every check.

lift.facts_fail: {n, plural, one {# check does not pass} other {# checks do not pass}}.
lift.label: Name of the design (optional)
lift.save_hint: The server redoes every calculation and saves the shaft design and the calculation together.
lift.fix_fields: Fix the marked fields to save.
lift.stage_label: The installation in 3D: shaft, car, counterweight, ropes and machine
lift.no3d: The 3D view is not available on this device: the simulation goes on in the charts and the values.
lift.about_loading: Car at the floor of the check, brake closed: people get in up to 1.25 times the rated load. The ropes must hold.
lift.about_stall: The counterweight rests on its buffers and the machine keeps turning upwards: the ropes must slip.
lift.sum_ride: From {from} to {to} with {load} kg: T1/T2 reaches at most {util} of the braking traction limit; motor torque up to {torque} N·m.
lift.sum_ride_over: From {from} to {to} with {load} kg: during the ride T1/T2 exceeds the braking traction limit ({util}); with the conventional friction the ropes would slip. Reduce the design acceleration or increase the traction (groove, wrap angle). Motor torque up to {torque} N·m.
lift.sum_brake_ok: The brake decelerates the car at {a} m/s²: T1/T2 reaches {util} of the limit and the ropes hold. Stop in {d0} cm.
lift.sum_brake_slip: The brake decelerates at {a} m/s²: T1/T2 asks {util} times the traction available and the ropes slip on the sheave. The car stops in {d1} cm instead of {d0} cm.
lift.sum_brake_runaway: The brake decelerates at {a} m/s², but T1/T2 passes the traction even with the car at rest: the ropes slip and the car runs on to the buffers.
lift.sum_brake_none: The brake does not stop the car: its torque ({tb} N·m) cannot hold it and the car runs on to the buffers.
lift.sum_brake_min: On its own the brake would decelerate at {a0} m/s²: the check uses the standard's minimum, {a} m/s².
lift.sum_loading_ok: With 1.25 times the rated load T1/T2 reaches {util} of the limit: the ropes hold and the car stays at the floor.
lift.sum_loading_fail: While loading T1/T2 passes the limit ({util}): the ropes slip and the car sinks with the doors open.
lift.sum_stall_ok: With the counterweight on its buffers T1/T2 reaches {efa} ({ratio}): the ropes slip and the car is not lifted.
lift.sum_stall_fail: With the counterweight on its buffers T1/T2 stays at {ratio} against {efa}: the ropes do not slip and the car is lifted toward the ceiling.
lift.sum_buffer_ok: Impact at 1.15 times the rated speed: the buffer compresses by {x} mm of {stroke} mm; peak deceleration {g} g.
lift.sum_buffer_fail: Impact at 1.15 times the rated speed: the stroke of {stroke} mm is not enough and the buffer goes solid.
lift.engineChanged: The software has changed since this design was saved: the values below are recomputed. For the documents, save the design again.
lift.unreadable: The saved design cannot be read by the current version of the software.
lift.docs_lead: Calculation report, plan in DXF and drawing sets come from the same data, with one click.
lift.docs_refused: The documents are not generated until the design is saved again with the current software.
